title: The Day the Fog Kept Secrets
skyStory: The moon has slipped into Pisces, seventy-one percent lit and dreamy as a cat in a sunbeam. It is not interested in plans today. It wants to float. Saturn has, astonishingly, agreed to take the afternoon off and is reading a novel. Mars is sulking but also kind of enjoying the quiet. The fog off the water has not lifted since breakfast and does not intend to.

reading: Pisces moon, soft edges everywhere. The Tiger is allowed to nap. Not a strategic nap. A genuine sprawl on the couch with a blanket, a window full of fog, and absolutely nothing being optimized.

Around 3:30 pm a memory from early in this year of readings will drift back to you, maybe a mission you did or a card that kept turning up. Let it play like a home movie. [[The Sun]] has been asking you to allow joy all year instead of earning it, and today is a final chance to practise. Do one thing simply because it is pleasant, then do not tell anyone about it. Some joys are just for you and the cabin.
joel.mission: Spend ten minutes doing nothing useful at all, on purpose, and notice the exact moment the guilt fades.
joel.omen: A candle flame standing perfectly still. Rest is the right answer today.
joel.stoneWhy: soft shine for a soft day

reading: The Wood Rat usually notices everything. Today, let something go unnoticed on purpose. A messy drawer, a strange email, a neighbour's questionable lawn ornament. The fog is covering for you. It is very good at secrets.

Find one quiet half hour this evening, a cup of something warm and a soft lamp. Think back over the year of readings and pick a single day you remember best. Do not explain to yourself why it stuck. Just let it sit there glowing. Tomorrow the year closes, and that memory is your ticket to the final page. The mother of pearl on your ring finger will feel slightly warmer when you have chosen.
nancy.mission: Leave one small mess completely alone today and wish it a pleasant evening when you walk past it.
nancy.omen: A streetlight glowing through fog like a little moon. Your favourite memory from this year is the right one.
nancy.elementWhy: the fog drifts, so do you

together.text: No missions together today. Just send each other one word at bedtime describing how the fog felt. Tomorrow is the final page of this year, and the sky wants you both rested and a little sentimental.
